summary: Iteration 15 — verified 4 bug fixes: (1) POST /api/jobs/cancel-stuck marks stale pending jobs failed (or deletes with delete=true) with job_type filter. (2) DELETE /api/pdf-sorter/runs/{run_id} deletes run doc + files, 404 for unknown. (3) GET /api/scheduler-status returns scheduler_running + jobs[] with auto_accept_poll job (cron */5) and non-null next_run_time; requires auth. (4) inventory-sync /history exposes result.note and result.debug_dir. Frontend: cancel-stuck-btn visible on /auto-accept and /live-inventory; scheduler-info pill shows 'Scheduler: running. Next auto-accept tick in 1 min.'; sync-note-<id> and sync-debug-<id> visible on Sync history tab after seeding; pl-delete-<run_id> trash icon visible on /printout-labels and clicking removes the row (confirm dialog auto-accepted). Scraper module inventory_sync_fetcher.py parses cleanly, contains _diagnose/_screenshot/debug_dir/landed_url/diagnostics markers (25 hits) and _urls() returning 2 candidate URLs. Regression pytest — 23/23 passed.
critical_code_review_comments: cancel_stuck endpoint enforces older_than_minutes>=1 via max(1, int(...)) — good. Uses timezone-aware UTC. Fine.
scheduler_status is registered directly on @app.get('/api/scheduler-status') instead of the @api router — inconsistent style but works. Consider moving under @api for consistency.

delete_run endpoint in pdf_sorter router does NOT have auth dependency (whereas cancel-stuck does). If pdf_sorter router applies auth at router level check is fine; otherwise this is an unauthenticated destructive endpoint. Recommend verifying router-level Depends(get_current_user).
React hydration warning still present on AutoAcceptPage line ~190 (<span> inside <option>) — cosmetic, unchanged from iteration 14.
seed_data_creation: Seeded fake inventory_sync job (test_seed=iter15-ui-inv) with note/debug_dir + fake pdf_sorter_runs doc (run_id=iter15-ui-run-xyz). All cleaned up post-test via pymongo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New endpoints work end-to-end. Scraper still cannot be executed in preview (no chrome/playwright) — only static validation done. If pdf-sorter delete_run needs auth, verify at router level (see code review comment #3).
